Historical background preview only; the active formal Puiseux input is now sourced to the inspected Mannaa-Coquand Corollary 1.10. No claim to have read the paywalled full chapter.

Section 1, Theorem 1.9 and Corollary 1.10 (printed pp. 6-7), including the Laurent-denominator reduction and proof. Applied to separable minimal polynomials over C((r)); characteristic zero supplies separability, and a common multiple of the finitely many root denominators gives one cover. No convergence assumption or arbitrary-ring conclusion.
